name: Orion Control
description: Validate, guard, independently verify, and durably record typed Orion TaskGraphs.

ledgerPath.description: Absolute or gateway-relative path for the append-only JSONL task ledger.

enableTestWorkspaceActions.description: Enable only the fixed-root Tier 1 test-workspace action catalog.

testWorkspaceRoot.description: Dedicated Orion-controlled root used only by Tier 1 test actions.

enableAppControlActions.description: Enable opening or gracefully quitting an explicitly named installed app.

enableBrowserControlActions.description: Enable guarded http/https browser tab control and visible-page reads.

browserPreference.description: Preferred supported browser, such as Opera Air or Safari.

enableMediaControlActions.description: Enable play/pause, track, volume, mute and display-sleep controls.

enableHomeReadActions.description: Enable guarded read-only access to visible non-sensitive home-directory paths.

homeRoot.description: Root used by guarded home-directory reads.

enableAmbientInfoActions.description: Enable weather, clock and local system-status reads.

defaultWeatherLocation.description: Default place for an otherwise unlocated weather request.

remindersPath.description: JSON file holding Orion-owned timers and alarms.

enableFileMutateActions.description: Enable guarded move, rename and delete-to-Trash actions in mutable roots.

trashRoot.description: Trash directory used for recoverable file deletion.

enableHealthTrackingActions.description: Enable supplement and workout writes to Orion's shared health log.

enableCalendarActions.description: Enable typed Apple Calendar and Apple Reminders mutations.

enableEpisodicCapture.description: Enable deterministic zero-model-token capture of high-signal user decisions and preferences.

episodicMemoryPath.description: Directory holding automatic daily episodic journals.

enableSelfTuningActions.description: Enable guarded tuning of Orion's fixed voice-timing settings.

enableSelfModificationActions.description: Enable guarded build-tested changes to Orion's native source.

enableSelfPluginActions.description: Enable build-tested, rollback-protected repair of Orion's control plugin.

enableSelfScriptsActions.description: Enable syntax-checked, rollback-protected repair of Orion wrapper scripts.

enableSelfConfigActions.description: Enable validated changes to Orion's closed configuration table.

trustAllowPromptSource.description: Accept the host-assembled turn prompt (llm_input) as an authenticated user turn when no raw channel message is available. Default true.

trustAllowSessionBinding.description: Accept a same-session authenticated turn when host run ids do not match. Default true.

trustAllowRecentBinding.description: Accept the newest authenticated user turn when the host did not bind this tool call to a run. Default true.

trustAllowTranscriptSource.description: Recover authenticated user turns from host-written local session transcripts.

trustTranscriptAgent.description: Agent whose session transcript supplies locally initiated user turns.

trustTtlMs.description: Age limit in milliseconds for run/session-bound authenticated turns. Default 900000.

trustRecentWindowMs.description: Age limit in milliseconds for the unbound recent-turn tier. Default 120000.

permissionStatePath.description: Private JSON state file for Orion's active permission profile.

permissionAuditPath.description: Private append-only JSONL audit file for permission changes.

workshopPath.description: JSON file holding Orion's proposed and approved composed tools. Defaults to .orion-control/workshop.json under the gateway working directory.
